schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The heart of the thing: an inspectable messaging pipe between components, and the ONLY path between them — sync (request/reply) and async (post), in place of MCP. The bus is its own process and every shim lives inside it. A DEVICE = its shim + its component(s) or the external thing it talks to: the librarian is a separate process its shim wakes and hands the message to; Calibre is all shim, talking to the Calibre db itself. Delivery is an event: a post lands in the bus's in-memory ring and the addressee's shim, in the same process, takes it at once — no DB, no clock. The ring goes to the db when the heartbeat pulse comes by (Akien 2026-09-06: "if the reciver wasn't that fast, that ring buffer would go to the db when the ground loop pulse came by") — persistence, never delivery, and the one thing messaging does on the beat. Durable transit rides db_domain (owner `bus`).
why: Akien, 2026-09-30: "The bus is the heart of the thing. it's intention is to be an inspectable messaging pipe between each component that is the only path between components (originally intended to be MCP). unlike conventional MCP, this can do both sync and async. the shims are part of the bus (same process). a device is a shim + it's component(s)." One door makes inspectable + logged automatic (Law 4); the shim in the bus process means a sleeping component costs nothing until a message arrives for it.
invoke: Send: `bus.post(sender=, to=, channel=, why=, body=, reply_to=None)` (async). Ask: `bus.request(...)` (sync — waits for the reply). Inspect: `bus.read(to=, channel=)`; `bus.digest(...)` collapses a diagnostic channel only. Prove: `python3 cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/proofs/test_bus.py`.
node_class: device — the heart; the peer of db_domain. db_domain owns durable state, the bus owns communication.
entry: Metaphor quarried from UU (per-device announce/personal/info/debug feeds; Postgres-backed envelopes). Cairn's: one door, riding db_domain, shims hosted in the bus process, sync+async on the one pipe.
state_and_history: compiled to state.json + history.json beside this charter
filed_edges: (a) the bus is its own process holding every shim — today shims run inside the ground loop's pulses; the move is a cast ticket's work

(b) the ring flush hears the pulse — today it runs inside bus_client's private loop; the bus process answers a `flush` verb sent by the ground loop's spawned pulse (tickets 48519f4789b1 D1 and acb4ecd84364). With every shim inside the one bus process there is no reader outside it, so the 2026-08-31 LISTEN/NOTIFY ruling has no consumer here.

(c) the shim wakes its component when it is not running — measured 2026-09-30: all 10 concrete shims define _start_device; the only one that raises is DiscoveredShim, the shim the probes/ rule invents for a folder with no shim.py, and ticket a808e21d646f (the device roster is the rack) retires that rule. Delivery itself is already an event in-process (BaseShim._check_mail runs at wiring and on the post-time poke, never per pulse); across processes it is ticket 48519f4789b1 (one bus process holds every shim).

(d) side doors close — measured 2026-09-30: device→device imports are already physics (device_isolation_holds, 0 live violations) and so are machine→device imports (machine_imports_no_device); bus_client's private BusDevice (reach, connect_bus) retires with 48519f4789b1; tools and skills importing device code (54 sites) is ticket 7b5c539cb58c, holding on open-6c699d2b81ef.
(e) an MCP adapter at the edge for outside callers
gates: proof gate — proofs/test_bus.py, bare and under the tester. Done means proven and committed.
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) a posted message does not read back with its why / sender / reply_to; (2) a whyless message or unknown channel is accepted; (3) a record channel collapses; (4) two components talk by any path but the bus; (5) a message waits on a clock tick to be delivered (the pulse may only persist the ring); (6) a message for a sleeping component is lost instead of waking it.
how_it_learns: It does not learn; it carries. Every message is a why-bearing causal record, so what the system said and why is readable evidence for whatever does learn.
traces_to: telos aim 1 (event, not poll — footprint shrinks)
owner: CC owns the bus code and proofs. The bus owns its transit table (owner `bus`) through db_domain.
proof: proofs/test_bus.py — round-trip with why + causality; refusals; record vs diagnostic; owner-gated transit.
provenance: Born 2026-07-18. Rewritten 2026-09-30 from Akien's statement of the bus's intention (quoted in why); the prior long form is in git history.
learns: It does not learn; it carries.
